theorem ibp2 {a b t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) {g g' g'' : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hg : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt g (g' x) x)
    (hg' : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt g' (g'' x) x)
    (hc : ContinuousOn g'' (Set.uIcc a b)) :
    ((2 * π * t) ^ 2 : ℂ) * ∫ u in a..b, e (-(u * t)) * (g u : ℂ) =
      2 * π * I * t * (e (-(b * t)) * g b - e (-(a * t)) * g a) +
        (e (-(b * t)) * g' b - e (-(a * t)) * g' a) - ∫ u in a..b, e (-(u * t)) * (g'' u : ℂ) :=

note: [H] (2.1) changed it (typo fixed: middle bound |hat{f^{(k)}}|_inf/(2 pi t) -> /(2 pi t)^k; hypothesis 'f of fast decay' added), so the link is at most related.
